title: Contagion Networks: Evaluator Bias Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
title_zh: Contagion Networks：多智能体 LLM 系统中的评估器偏差传播
abstract_en: When large language models serve as evaluators in multi-agent systems, their systematic evaluation biases propagate through the agent network. We introduce Contagion Networks, a formal framework for measuring how evaluator biases spread across interacting LLM agents. In a controlled 3-agent experiment using DeepSeek-chat with three distinct evaluator bias profiles (structured, balanced, evidence-based), we measure the Cross-Agent Contagion Matrix Gamma_3 and find that evaluator biases consistently propagate between agents (gamma in [0.157, 0.352]), even within the same underlying model. We identify three propagation regimes governed by the spectral radius rho(Gamma_N), and demonstrate that homogeneous-model agents produce contagion coefficients 3-5x weaker than cross-model coefficients observed in prior work (MM-EPC: gamma approx 0.85-1.3), placing them in the suppression regime. We show that increasing evaluator committee size from k=1 to k=3 reduces effective contagion by 72.4%, providing an actionable mitigation strategy. We release the open-source Contagion Network experimental framework.
abstract_zh: 本文研究当大型语言模型在多智能体系统中担任评估器时，其系统性评估偏差如何沿智能体网络传播。作者提出 Contagion Networks，一个用于量化评估器偏差在交互式 LLM agents 之间扩散的形式化框架。通过使用 DeepSeek-chat 进行受控 3-agent 实验，并设置 structured、balanced、evidence-based 三种不同评估器偏差画像，论文测量了 Cross-Agent Contagion Matrix Gamma_3，发现即使底层模型相同，偏差仍会稳定地在 agents 间传播，传播系数 gamma 位于 0.157 到 0.352。作者进一步基于谱半径 rho(Gamma_N) 识别出三种传播机制，并指出同质模型 agents 的传播系数比先前工作 MM-EPC 中观察到的跨模型系数弱 3 到 5 倍，因此处于 suppression regime。实验还表明，将评估委员会规模从 k=1 增加到 k=3，可使有效偏差传播降低 72.4%，提供了可操作的缓解策略。论文同时开源了 Contagion Network 实验框架。
key_points_zh: 提出 Contagion Networks，用于形式化测量多智能体 LLM 系统中评估器偏差的跨智能体传播。
在 DeepSeek-chat 的 3-agent 受控实验中，发现 structured、balanced、evidence-based 等偏差画像会稳定传播，gamma 为 0.157–0.352。
基于 Cross-Agent Contagion Matrix Gamma_N 的谱半径 rho(Gamma_N)，论文划分出三种偏差传播 regime。
同质模型 agents 的偏差传播强度显著低于先前跨模型系统 MM-EPC，约弱 3–5 倍，整体处于 suppression regime。
将评估委员会规模从 k=1 提升到 k=3，可将有效传播降低 72.4%，是简单且可落地的偏差缓解方法。

llm_assessment.comment: The paper gives an interesting formal lens on evaluator-bias propagation in multi-agent systems, but its harness-level operational relevance is still moderate.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该论文为多智能体系统中的评估器偏差传播提供了有趣的形式化视角，但其对运行框架层面的运营价值仍属中等。
